summary.intent: Run the audit-fix pipeline against cipher-box UAT/verification findings, classify issues as auto-fixable vs manual-only, and autonomously fix auto-fixable findings with test verification and atomic commits.
summary.outcome: The F-03 fix (BYO status wiring in StorageTab) was implemented and verified (tsc, eslint, 23/23 web tests passing), but the commit never confirmed due to repeated SSH signing hangs via 1Password's op-ssh-sign. The pipeline stalled at the first commit; no subsequent findings were processed.

repo: Several audit findings (duplicate MetricsService imports, fetch binding, orphaned FUSE files) were already resolved on main before the session started — UAT docs can lag actual codebase state.
The repo enforces SSH signature verification on PRs, so --no-gpg-sign is not a viable fallback.
Commit signing is routed through 1Password's op-ssh-sign binary; sandboxed shell environments block it from reaching the 1Password agent, causing silent hangs rather than explicit errors.
The BYO status advisory flag flows through fetchQuota() — calling vaultControllerSetByoStatus then fetchQuota() in sequence is the correct pattern to update the storage badge after mode changes.

code.finding: BYO status was not wired into the save flow; fix adds vaultControllerSetByoStatus({ isByo: mode !== 'cipherbox' }) after successful pinning-config save (non-fatal on failure), followed by the existing fetchQuota() call to refresh the badge.

workflow: Sandboxed Bash tool calls block op-ssh-sign from reaching the 1Password agent; signed commits must be run unsandboxed or the user must approve via 1Password UI before the process times out.
Background task status alone is insufficient to detect SSH signing hangs — the process sits alive in sign_buffer_ssh with no timeout, requiring explicit process inspection (ps/pstree) to diagnose.
Killing hung op-ssh-sign and restarting 1Password before retrying is the recovery path when the signing prompt never surfaces.

friction: op-ssh-sign repeatedly hung waiting for 1Password authorization; no prompt surfaced in the UI across multiple attempts.
Sandboxed shell environment silently blocked the SSH signer from reaching the 1Password agent — the error manifested as a hang rather than a clear failure message.
Multiple kill/retry cycles (at least 3) were needed with no successful commit by session end.
1Password app required a restart mid-session to attempt recovery.
Commit exit code 128 on one attempt gave no actionable detail without reading the raw output file.
open_items: Confirm whether the final background commit (task bxww1h9u2) for F-03 landed after the session ended — the fix is staged in StorageTab.tsx and ready.
Resume the audit-fix pipeline for remaining auto-fixable findings (F-04, F-05, etc.) once F-03 commit is confirmed.
Investigate why 1Password signing prompts are not surfacing in the UI during background Bash tasks — may need a hook or permission setting to allow unsandboxed git commits.
